properties.description: RoboDR findings -> RoboDRFindings_CL through the Logs Ingestion API, one finding per JSON object. Stream Custom-RoboDRFindingsRaw: findings nobody verified (Event Hubs, a Logstash Sentinel output); it does not declare robodr_verification, so VerificationStatus is always empty there whatever the finding says. Stream Custom-RoboDRFindingsVerified: only the output of integrations/verify/robodr_verify.py; VerificationStatus is the status that verifier wrote.
